scope: Hear spoken text and keep the keyboard ready.

topics.title: Choose when to hear your text
details: Open Verbosity, then Echo dictated text. Choose phrase by phrase, at the end of a sentence, or do not echo dictated text.
Phrase by phrase is the default. Readback starts after a short pause. It speaks your text with no Added label. Typing echo has its own choice.

topics.title: Keep editing after speech
details: Old cursor updates no longer block the text window after speech adds words. The app keeps the latest text and makes the keyboard ready again.
Both Dictation type choices have tests for text and mail. AI-based trims clear false starts. Old school keeps the usual words. Both use the current saved choice.
